intro: Agamaggan's Strength is a repeatable ritual offered by the captive quilboar Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo. By exchanging red Blood Shards harvested across the Barrens, travelers are granted the potent physical might revered by the Razormane tribe's greatest warriors. It fuels Mangletooth's bitter hatred of the rival Bristleback quilboar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, traveler.
Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing.
The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!

clips.title: Completion
paras: If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him!
I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you.
